name: Astronomy
notes: Seven courses: a three-course introductory physics sequence, ASTR 142, two 200-level astronomy courses, and one further introductory astronomy course.
DEPARTMENT-CODE TRANSLATION: the PAS pages write 'AST' and 'PHY' where the registrar's catalog uses ASTR and PHYS.
A student must attain an average of at least 2.0 in all introductory 100-level astronomy, physics and mathematics courses. Physics majors CAN minor in astronomy.
The undergraduate astronomy advisor must approve all course choices.

requirementGroups.label: Introductory physics sequence
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following introductory sequences: PHYS 121, 122 and 123; PHYS 141, 142 and 143

requirementGroups.label: Elementary astrophysics
requirementGroups.note: The department page writes 'AST 142'; the registrar's catalog prefix is ASTR.

requirementGroups.label: One additional introductory astronomy course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One additional introductory astronomy course: ASTR 102: Relativity, Black Holes and The Big Bang; ASTR 104: The Solar System; ASTR 105: Milkyway Galaxy; ASTR 106: Cosmic Origins of Life; ASTR 111: The Solar System and Its Origin*. *ASTR 111 covers the material in more depth than ASTR 104, and is recommended for the minor.
requirementGroups.note: ASTR 111 is listed first because the department recommends it over ASTR 104.
